nuggets.text: The Aggies' trip to Honolulu covers 6,420 round-trip miles, their longest road journey of the season.
Nick Session returned an interception 26 yards for a touchdown on the very first play of the Aggies' home opener.
Terrione Graves' 83-yard touchdown catch against Mercyhurst was the Aggies' longest passing score since 2014.
Tony Sanchez went 85-5 as a Las Vegas high school coach, winning a state title every season, before leading the Aggies.
The 1960 Aggies went 11-0, still the only perfect season in school history.
Kicker Ilya Uvaydov made five field goals of 50-plus yards at Utah Tech in 2025, with a long of 55.
James Jones once piled up 158 rushing yards on just three carries for Delaware State.
The Aggies once went 57 seasons between bowl games, from 1960 to 2017.
Aggies coach Tony Sanchez is coaching his alma mater, where he caught 54 passes as a wide receiver.
The Aggies have forced a turnover in 18 straight games, a streak dating back to 2024.
